name: .gitignore Generator
description: Generate a clean .gitignore file for common programming languages, frameworks, IDEs and operating systems.
search_intent: Create a .gitignore file by selecting development stacks, editors and operating systems.

inputs.label: Technologies
inputs.help: Select one or more languages, frameworks, IDEs or operating systems.

calculation: Generate deterministic .gitignore content from locally maintained template groups. Merge selected groups, preserve useful comments, remove duplicate patterns and produce a clean newline-terminated file. Include common options such as Node.js, Next.js, Python, Java, Go, Rust, macOS, Windows, Linux, VS Code and JetBrains. Do not make network calls.
limitations: Generated rules are general defaults and may need adjustment for a specific repository.
Do not automatically ignore project files that may be required in source control.
All generation should occur locally in the browser.
